analysis.title: Sempra (SRE): First Take: 3Q EPS beat vs. GSe/Street; risk to 2027 EPS from CA
key_insights: Sempra reported 3Q26 adjusted EPS of $1.40, above GSe $1.25 and FactSet consensus $1.24.

The beat came from higher EPS at SIP, California and Oncor, slightly offset by lower EPS at Parent. Segment EPS vs GSe: SIP $0.36 vs $0.27, California $0.57 vs $0.52, Oncor $0.70 vs $0.68, Parent ($0.23) vs ($0.21).
Operating net income was $917mn vs GSe $826mn (+11%). SIP was $237mn vs $178mn (+33%).

On the income statement, gross margin was $2,689mn vs GSe $2,939mn. Lower interest, O&M, D&A and income tax expense offset it. Net interest expense was $263mn vs GSe $378mn, and income tax was $66mn vs $83mn.
Sempra reiterated 2026 EPS guidance of $4.80-$5.30 and expects the high end of the range. It also reiterated 2027 guidance of $5.10-$5.70. GSe is $5.27 for 2026 and $5.61 for 2027.
The company expects to close the SIP sale within the next two weeks.

The company flagged risk of landing toward the lower end of 2027 guidance. The cause is the CPUC's unfavorable decision on the 2024 GRC capital attrition mechanism. The company continues to pursue remedies.
GS expects management to discuss a roughly 20% increase to the Oncor capital plan. System peak load at Oncor rose from 31 GW to 33 GW in 3Q.
GS is encouraged by the earnings execution and higher Oncor capital expectations. It awaits management color on implications from the Texas election results.

GS expects the call to focus on the Texas outlook and data center/transmission capex, California legislative updates after no structural wildfire liability reform, and the SIP stake sale with its credit implications.
GS rates SRE Buy with a 12-month SOTP-based price target of $103 vs a $82.90 price (24.2% upside).

market_movers.rationale: 3Q adjusted EPS of $1.40 beat GSe and consensus, and Oncor capital expectations are rising. Risk to 2027 EPS comes from the unfavorable CPUC decision on the 2024 GRC capital attrition mechanism.

SRE reiterated 2026 EPS guidance of $4.80-$5.30, expecting the high end. GSe 2026E EPS is $5.27.
SRE reiterated 2027 EPS guidance of $5.10-$5.70, with risk of landing toward the lower end because of the CPUC 2024 GRC capital attrition decision. GSe 2027E EPS is $5.61.

risk_factors: Constructive regulatory outcomes (as listed in the report).

No structural wildfire liability reform passed in California this session.
Texas election results could affect data center capex and the 765kv transmission buildout.
SIP sale closing and the cushion relative to the ~14%-15% FFO/debt thresholds.
